name: Spots
tagline: Place every tile • Match the regions
description: Place every domino so each region’s rule is true

rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Place the full set of tiles so every cell is covered exactly once
rules.rule2: A number is the region’s spot sum; = means all equal; ≠ means all different
rules.rule3: Tiles may only sit on two cells that share a side
